2610.13896.title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
2610.13896.paper_summary: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens. Under tight length limits, it improves Smatch++ over local masking by 5.1 and 2.4 points on DRS and by 6.4 and 3.2 points on AMR, comparable to rollback under the same limit, which retracts tokens. For post hoc processing, invalid outputs concentrate on the same inputs: eight unconstrained samples yield no valid output for 10.2% of inputs with limited training data, compared with 0.4% with full data, where filtering comes within 0.2 Smatch++ points of APD. For training, penalizing automaton-rejected tokens improves development Smatch++ by 3.6-11.0 points after 10% of training, but this advantage diminishes as cross-entropy alone reduces the probability assigned to rejected tokens from 14% to below 2% within the first sixth of training with limited data.
2610.13896.paper_summary_zh: 神經語義解析器逐字生成意義表示，但良好的結構取決於生成過程中展開的參考、範圍和圖形關係。受限解碼防止局部無效的符號，但不保證在固定的輸出長度限制內可以完成有效的前綴。我們在三個階段的DRS解析中調查結構自動機（解碼、事後處理和訓練），並額外評估AMR上的解碼。對於解碼，我們引入接受路徑解碼（APD），它在剩餘長度限制內保持已驗證的完成，並在該符號也可以完成時遵循模型的首選符號。APD保證接受的輸出而不撤回符號。在嚴格的長度限制下，它在DRS上比局部屏蔽提高了5.1和2.4點，在AMR上提高了6.4和3.2點，與在相同限制下撤回符號的回滾相當。對於事後處理，無效輸出集中在相同的輸入上：八個不受限的樣本對於有限訓練數據的10.2%的輸入沒有產生有效輸出，而全數據的比例為0.4%，過濾接近於APD的0.2 Smatch++點。對於訓練，懲罰自動機拒絕的符號在10%的訓練後提高了開發Smatch++ 3.6-11.0點，但隨著交叉熵單獨降低被拒絕符號的概率從14%降至有限數據訓練的前六分之一內的2%以下，這一優勢減少。
2610.13896.author: Xiao Zhang et.al.
